target_customer: Software developers and product teams that send transactional and lifecycle notifications across channels
problem: Developers had to integrate and maintain multiple email, SMS, push and chat providers for notifications.
business_model: Usage-based API and SaaS for notification infrastructure

founders.name: Troy Goode
founders.background_notes: Per TechCrunch June 2022. The YC page lists no founders by name.

technical_complexity.rationale: Routing, templating, preferences and delivery reliability across providers is standard but broad API engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Integration into customers' send paths creates some lock-in, but providers and rivals could replicate routing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Twilio and Slack invested rather than competing; Twilio later became a Courier customer (Courier case study). No acquisition confirmed.

market_need_then: Not strongly documented near 2019; Twilio and Slack strategic investment in the 2020 Series A suggests demand for orchestration over their channels.

branding.domain_note: Holds courier.com (the YC site field and live site use it); acquisition date not found.

identity.logo: A bird inside the first letter of the word (per a Courier page)
identity.voice_and_tone: Developer-focused, positioned as Stripe for notifications on the YC page

brand_strength.rationale: Exact-match dictionary name on a .com and clear delivery metaphor, but generic and no evidence of community or press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Courier raised about 47.5 million dollars through June 2022 across a seed, a Series A led by Bessemer with Twilio, SendGrid and Slack participating, and a 35 million Series B led by GV, and had over 150 paying customers by then. YC lists it as Acquired, but I found no acquisition announcement and courier.com still operates as an independent product, so the exit is recorded as unknown. The 2022 coverage names MagicBell and Notifo as competitors, but those were not found in sources from the batch period.
notes: YC status Acquired conflicts with finding no acquisition; exit left unknown. One directory marked acquired with no buyer or date. Funding after June 2022 not searched successfully. MagicBell and Notifo come from a 2022 article so are excluded from competition as of founding. Education not found.
